format: Vanilla 26.3 terrain with the Beardifier. chunks: one per line: dimension, seed, min_y, height, structure and start [chunk x, z] (the first start of that structure in structure_starts; the targets, all at the z of the centre of its first piece: the chunk of that centre, the chunk west of it and the chunk of the block west of the start's bounding box, without repeats), x, z, references (as in structure_references), beardifier {starts: [[structure id, start chunk x, z], ...] that Beardifier.forStructuresInChunk got from StructureManager.startsForStructure, sorted (Vanilla's order follows a HashMap of Structure objects and changes between JVM runs; the float sum of the contributions follows it, but the recorded chunks gave the same blocks in either order), rigids, junctions: number of entries, affected_box or null}, then noise/surface/carvers snapshots in the format of chunk.json, taken after doFill, buildSurface and generateCarvers of a NoiseChunk built with that Beardifier (no blending). Starts come from createStructures on fresh chunks; the references of the chunk from createReferences.
